L = float(params.get('length', 200))
W = params['width']
T = params['thickness']
R = params['corner_radius']
D = params['mounting_hole_diameter']
O = params['mounting_hole_offset']
C = params['center_hole_diameter']
x = L/2 - O
y = W/2 - O
assert R < min(L,W)/2, '外角半径必须小于长宽的一半'
assert O > D/2, '安装孔必须与外边界保留材料'
assert x > D/2, '长度与边距导致安装孔重合'
assert y > D/2, '宽度与边距导致安装孔重合'
assert C < min(L,W), '中央孔必须小于底座长宽'
assert math.sqrt(x*x+y*y) > (C+D)/2, '中央孔与安装孔相交'
if O < R:
    assert math.sqrt(2)*(R-O)+D/2 < R, '安装孔穿出圆角边界'
body = cq.Workplane('XY').box(L, W, T, centered=(True,True,False))
body = body.edges('|Z').fillet(R)
points = [(-x,-y), (x,-y)] + [(-x,y), (x,y)]
body = body.faces('>Z').workplane().pushPoints(points).hole(D)
result = body.faces('>Z').workplane().hole(C)
title: 参数化设备安装底座 CAD 模型
